title: Uiopiks Vanilla
description: A pack enhancing the vanilla experience
body:
A Small Pack to Enhance Vanilla

This modpack focuses on improving visuals, atmosphere, and overall immersion without changing the core gameplay. It is perfect for GAMERS who want a more beautiful and immersive Minecraft experience while keeping things close to vanilla.

Disclaimer:

None of the mods are mine — all credit goes to the original mod creators.
If you have questions, issues, or suggestions about the modpack, feel free to contact me on Discord: uiopik
